# FutureLearn

> FutureLearn is an online learning platform offering free courses, career development resources, and personalized learning guidance through partnerships with leading universities and professional services.

FutureLearn provides accessible digital education through partnerships with institutions like the University of Leeds and the Institute of Coding, complemented by career support services and structured learning guidance to help users develop professional skills and advance their employability.

## Key Topics

- career development
- study tips
- learning strategies
- employability
- CV review
- free courses
- goal setting
- time management
- learning styles
- digital skills
- professional feedback
- job search
- community learning
- University partnerships

## Career Development & Employability

- [CV Review Service](https://cv-review.futurelearn.com/): Free CV review service partnership with TopCV for career development and professional feedback

## Free Courses & Digital Skills

- [Click Start: Free Digital Courses](https://click-start.futurelearn.com/): Click Start digital skills courses with University of Leeds partnership offering free professional development

## Learning Guidance & Study Resources

- [Your Learning Guide: Study Tips](https://learning-guide.futurelearn.com/about): Study tips and learning strategies guide covering goal-setting, time management, learning styles, and effective study advice for FutureLearn users
